what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8817 Pakistani refugees in Germany, 9.7% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level in some years, with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002, and the figure was at its highest, 10815, at the end of 2005.
It fell to a low in 2013 and then rose again; the main years of displacement in the data include 2002 to 2005, 2009 to 2012 and 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
